entries.en: to plan or scheme; to set out the chess game (trazar, disponer la axedrez).

entries.zh: 机窍；事情的机要关键与全部底细。
entries.en: the secret workings or knack of a thing; all the ins and outs (todo lo que ha).
entries.notes: 西语栏有删字痕迹，全义展开依赖推断。

entries.zh: 窍妙；事理的精微机窍（西语entresijo本指布匹经纬交错处，喻内里精微）。
entries.en: the subtle inner workings or essence of a matter (entresijo: crosswise thread of a weave, fig.).

entries.zh: 设心；存心图谋（或存歹心）。
entries.en: to design in one's mind; to intend or scheme (note ends 'malo', ill intent).
entries.notes: L词头traçavertré有涂改圈划难辨，M栏尾语mayzita malo难解，释义以汉字'設心'为准。

entries.zh: 张设大旗以行骗；虚张旗号。
entries.en: to set up a big flag in order to deceive.
entries.notes: 汉字'大面旗'为名词，与西语'设谋行骗'的衔接依赖推断（理解为设旗行骗）。

entries.zh: 设谋行骗（词头首字存疑，或为'竭谋'）。
entries.en: to scheme in order to deceive (first character of the headword doubtful).
entries.notes: 汉字[疑:嵑/竭]，且M栏四音节与二字词头不合；西语'p a'为para之缩写，展开依赖推断。

entries.en: to set up a plot or scheme in order to deceive.

entries.notes: 西语栏涂改难辨（traçar cöfer bagens para apóco-），依汉字'深謀'与M栏tsîm-bô定释义。

entries.zh: 用心机；费心机（或善或恶地运筹）。
entries.en: to use one's wits or cunning, for good or ill (trazar bien o mal).

entries.zh: 传；相传（前人相传之传统）。
entries.en: to transmit or hand down; tradition (of our elders — 'de nuestros…' runs on).
handed down from generation to generation (tradition of our elders).
to hand down and pass along.
to teach or impart what one received (tradición antigua, recibida).

entries.zh: 传流万古；万古相传（极古之传统）。
entries.en: transmitted through all ages; a most ancient tradition (muy antigua).
to wear hanging at the neck; to carry on one's person.

entries.zh: 佩；佩带于腰间（腰带上悬铁铃等佩物）。
entries.en: to wear (a pendant) at the girdle; note partly illegible: steel jingles or [illegible] hung on the sash.
entries.notes: 西语行间补注两处[残]、M栏有污渍(T99)，释义依'佩'字本义及'encolgadas en la cinta'可辨部分，佩物细节不全。

entries.en: to transport or convey (L column truncated after 'cedelo').
entries.notes: 西语栏'cedelo'后残缺难辨，依汉字'運'与M栏ún定'运送'义。
西语栏'traer piernas torcaz, toballor'难辨且与'辣'义不合，依汉字'辣'与M栏loá定味觉义。

entries.zh: 〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕（字或为'搔'搔痒，或为'橈'弯曲）
entries.en: damaged original, gloss doubtful (possibly 搔 'to scratch' per M 'so', or 橈 'bent/crooked' per the crooked-legs gloss).
entries.notes: 汉字[疑:橈/搔]两可：M栏'so'近搔音而西语'piernas torcas'近橈之弯曲义，语义无法定夺。
